messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: SMART-ROUTING / fallback-loop (sev2) - high error rate and repeated cross-region hops; paging oncall

anna_ops: acked. I'll take this. please post timelines + any customer impact.

mike_k: starting timeline - I see a jump in 502/5xx and long tail latencies from router pool at ~03:14 UTC. Traces show requests bouncing between regions (us-west-2 <-> eu-west-1) and several retries.

anjali_r: quick sample - payloads routed to variant "gpt-4-compat-legacy" which our tokenizer layer rejects for certain prompt encodings. Also fallback_policy logs are showing no hop limits, so requests keep being retried across regions until client gives up.

eli_chen: running a policy-eval audit now. Querying policy_decisions for presence of route_tag/route_id in decision context.

eli_chen: query result: ~21,490 decisions in the last 24h with null route_tag. That explains why it's hard to tie decisions to policy versions. observability gap = real.

jordan_l: looks like policy sr-policy-cascade-3 was edited yesterday. The return clause was changed from structured json to a simple string (return: variant) during a quick tweak, so we lost route metadata. That plus a wildcard alias for compat variants allowed the older variant to match.\
sam_t: customer impact dashboard: overall /v1/generate error rate peaked 14% between 03:14-03:28 UTC. Key affected customers: FinAssist (enterprise) saw chat flows drop, a few PLG trials had timeouts. Need to notify accounts.

ben_p: tagging accounts/product. FinAssist SLA may be hit. Mitigation plan?

anna_ops: propose immediate actions: 1) pause sr-policy-cascade-3 rollout; 2) emergency pin highest-risk customers to stable variants; 3) temporarily increase routing decision verbosity to include route_tag & policy_version; 4) add hop cap at routing layer while we investigate. Who can run 2 and 4?

mike_k: I can pin customers. Hitting control-plane. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/pins
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -d '{"customer_id":"finassist","model":"gpt-4","variant":"gpt-4-stable","expires_in":"60m"}'
```

mike_k: pin applied for FinAssist and two other flagged customers.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused: sr-policy-cascade-3 by anna_ops

eli_chen: implementing a hotfix: policy-engine will enforce that policy returns structured decision contexts {variant_id, route_tag, policy_version}. Also adding a fallback cap max_hops=3 at the router to prevent infinite cross-region bouncing. Pushing a canary to 3 routers now.

anjali_r: root cause summary draft: (A) policy-return contract regresssion removed route metadata during a change; (B) variant aliasing allowed fallback to an incompatible compat variant; (C) no hop limit in fallback policy allowed repeated cross-region attempts; (D) decision logs lacked route_tag so detection was delayed.\
eli_chen: canary shows healthy on routers: rtr-07, rtr-08, rtr-09. Decision logs now include route_tag. Audit post-fix: count of null route_tag in last 24h -> 4,612 (was 21,490). Good improvement.

mike_k: verifying error curve - after canary and pins, error rate dropped from 14% to ~1% by 03:44 UTC.

support-bot: customer notification queued for FinAssist and others. Draft message attached for review.

sam_t: customer comms note (draft): "We experienced a routing policy regression causing degraded responses 03:14-03:44 UTC. We've pinned your traffic to a stable variant and deployed a fix. We'll follow up with a detailed postmortem and credits where applicable."

ben_p: schedule ops/pm sync in 1 hour to evaluate SLA exposure and credit estimates.

jordan_l: action items (short):
- enforce policy schema validation in CI (owner: eng-platform)
- add lint rule to block policy edits that change return shape without explicit version bump (owner: eng-runtime)
- add metric: fraction of decisions with null route_tag (owner: observability)
- set default max_fallback_hops=3 for cascading policies (owner: oncall-runbooks)

jordan_l: longer-term: add end-to-end test simulating variant alias resolution mismatch, and add canary that validates returned variant compatibility with backend tokenizers.

anna_ops: handing off to eli for post-incident writeup. I'm offcall in 10. Good work team.

eli_chen: taking postmortem lead. I'll collect timelines, attach traces, and own follow-ups. Incident downgraded to sev3 at 03:48 UTC and marked resolved after rollout completion.

deploy-bot: Incident marked resolved by eli_chen at 03:48:12 UTC

incident-bot: Incident closed: SMART-ROUTING / fallback-loop - duration ~34m - postmortem id pm-2026-03-15-03

sam_t: will file customer-facing summary and loop in accounts for FinAssist.

anna_ops: thanks all. please post any missing notes in this thread before I sign off.
